name: Priya Sharma
headline: Senior Data Analyst | SQL, Python, Tableau
summary: Data analyst with 4 years of experience turning retail sales and operations data into actionable business insights. Proven track record of owning end-to-end analyses, from SQL extraction and A/B testing to Tableau dashboard creation and stakeholder presentations.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Built 12 Tableau dashboards used weekly by 40 regional managers to track retail sales performance against business targets.
Automated monthly revenue reporting workflows using Python and SQL, reducing preparation time from 3 days to 4 hours.
Designed and analysed A/B tests on checkout process modifications, resulting in a 6% conversion rate lift.
Collaborated with cross-functional finance and supply chain teams to define key performance indicators and deliver stakeholder presentations.

experience.title: Junior Analyst
bullets: Cleaned and merged shipment dataset across 5 warehouse systems into a unified central reporting table using SQL.
Created quantitative Excel models to forecast weekly delivery volumes for logistics operations.
Fulfilled 120 ad hoc data analysis requests for operations managers to support daily operational decisions.

projects.name: Customer churn model
bullets: Trained a logistic regression model on public telecom data, achieving an evaluation metric of 0.81 AUC.
